queries.sql: SELECT q.* FROM (SELECT j.id AS journal_id, j.journal_date AS date, j.description, j.source_type, j.source_reference, j.reversal_of_id, l.line_number, l.debit, l.credit, SUM(l.debit - l.credit) OVER (ORDER BY j.journal_date, j.id, l.line_number ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_movement FROM pl_journal_lines l JOIN pl_journals j ON j.id = l.journal_id AND j.company_id = l.company_id AND j.book_id = l.book_id WHERE l.account_id = ? AND l.company_id = ? AND l.book_id = ? AND j.journal_date <= ? AND j.journal_date >= ?) q ORDER BY q.date ASC, q.date, q.journal_id, q.line_number LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
